column1: # Fluent Forever 'Your First 625' (Gabriel Wyner, thematic order), Cebuano (tunatale-u8nz, 2026-09-26).
# Translations drafted by the orchestrator, then gated against the kaikki.org Cebuano extract.
# status: dictionary = headword with a compatible gloss; variant = listed as an alternative form (spelling kept because it is the common one);
#   usage = no headword, but used >= 5 times in the dictionary's example sentences; reviewed = headword whose gloss wording differs, meaning checked by hand;
#   unconfirmed = the dictionary cannot confirm it (mostly loanwords the extract lacks). NOT minted unless the user accepts it.
#   accepted = was unconfirmed; accepted by the user on 2026-09-26 (76 rows; the other 4 were already cards).
# Words dropped: multi-word entries (train station, son, daughter...), grammar labels, senses Cebuano shares one word for, and pink/adult (dictionary disagrees).
